newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring up on cold weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring up on cold weather.

text.p: Harsh winter weather and the resulting transportation problems caused most spring wheat premiums in U.S. cash markets to jump higher Wednesday, cash sources said.
"We're up again today (Wednesday) because of the weather, and because of the railroads' not being able to move cars," said one Minnesota-based trader said.

Heavy snow drifts and bitter cold temperatures in spring wheat growing areas have halted rail transportation in some areas. Additionally, farmers have no way to move their grain to market, cash sources said.
"Nothing is trading because of the weather," said one Montana-based dealer.
There were also reports that spring wheat millers who could not obtain spring wheat by rail were seeking hard red winter wheat instead, sources said.
